description: This is the sound of a small waterfall river running during a rainy afternoon in Brazilian paradise called Boa Esperança de Cima, near Lumiar, in Rio de Janeiro, known for its beautiful and cinematographic waterfalls. This is me, staring at this river for a few minutes, near a chalet rented from dear friends in a place named Floresta Encantada. Look for this paradise at Google.  Recorded with a stereo Zoom H4N in 24 bits 48000hz
name: Brazilian_Waterfall_River .wav
